description:
## Goal

Make the one retained InputFlowRelation preserve each direct-call argument frame atomically, including normalized local constants and exact origin-path operands. Relational semantic questions must substitute one real frame, never Cartesianize independent input columns or reconstruct information discarded by the relation.

## Proven defects

DirectCallFlow stores independent input columns. Coherent frames {(a,b),(c,d)} and crossed frames {(a,d),(c,b)} therefore collapse to the same fact even though equality of the two callee inputs has different meaning.

Local values also disappear. same(x, :hit) and same(x, :miss) retain equal relations because constants are represented as empty binding sets.

The first correlated-frame implementation exposed the deeper cause: input_flow separately interpreted every LoweredStep variant and omitted lambda captures, dynamic bitstring sizes, and BitstringRead outputs. Variant-by-variant repairs would preserve the wrong model. jobs/body.rs, jobs/artifact.rs, and executable_facts.rs also independently enumerate definitions or reads.

## Correct-by-construction model

LoweredStep owns one borrowed, allocation-free typed semantic-role view. It exhaustively destructures every variant and every field without catch-all field patterns. The view distinguishes:

- every definition, including zero-input and multi-output results;
- typed source-to-result contributions using the existing structural and whole-dependency path algebra;
- evaluation-only or assertion reads that do not contribute to a retained result;
- AssertSame equalities within their existing control-local scope.

This is the sole generic authority for which values a lowered step defines and reads and how operands contribute to results. Input-flow extraction consumes the view and owns only correlation, alias resolution, typed path composition, and frame normalization. It must not match opcodes to rediscover their value semantics.

The distinction between contribution and evaluation-only read is authoritative. Overwritten map members and literal key operands may still be executable reads without becoming semantic dependencies. Conservatism must name exactly the operands a result may read, not every syntactic operand nearby.

One DirectCallFlow owns a canonical set of complete call-input frames. Each frame is one real correlated alternative across all callee inputs; zero arguments is one empty frame. A slot retains normalized literal denotation, exact InputFlowOrigin with typed path and pullback, or an explicitly conservative local term naming its exact contributing operands. No display text, source spelling, span, ValueId, ControlEntryId, Ty allocation order, or rendered type is retained as semantic identity.

Structural projection and construction reuse InputPathStep and compose_paths. Dynamic map selectors, exclusions, remainders, list, tuple, and bitstring paths do not gain a second walker. Control-flow choice markers exist only during extraction and are stripped from the retained fact.

Relational questions retain one normalized QuestionTemplate plus an operand tuple. Equality canonicalizes operand swap; ordering canonicalizes by swapping operands and reversing the operator; repeated-role aliasing is explicit. Literal substitution reduces to the exact unary question when possible.

The existing World InputFlow fact remains the sole authority. Equal normalized frame sets retain allocation and generation and wake nobody. Source replacement withdraws obsolete frames exactly.

## TDD

1. RED from the clean predecessor: same(x, :hit) and same(x, :miss) retain equal relations. After the cutover, their exact pullbacks differ and do not demand the constant slot.
2. RED from the clean predecessor: coherent and crossed two-input alternatives collapse. Retained frame sets remain distinct and no impossible frame is invented.
3. A capturing lambda passed as an argument retains the capture origin in that exact frame.
4. Constructed bitstrings retain dynamic size origins. Every BitstringRead output retains its applicable reader and dynamic-size origins.
5. Multi-output definitions survive retained-value and artifact boundaries.
6. An overwritten known map field remains an evaluation operand where required but its obsolete value does not contribute a semantic frame dependency.
7. Equality swap, ordering reversal, repeated operands, and literal substitution have canonical typed identities independent of mint or arrival order.
8. Projected and constructed tuple, list, map, bitstring, delivered-result, protocol, and direct-forwarding operands stay correlated through the exact callsite.
9. Two calls to one callee never cross-connect. Two independent merges produce exactly their real joint alternatives. Zero arguments produces one empty frame.
10. Branch, source, and job-order permutations reproduce byte-equal content. Equal publication retains allocation and revision and schedules no reader. Replacement retracts only obsolete frames.
11. Add a composition fixture where an input controls a dynamic bitstring size, the resulting value is captured, and that closure crosses a direct-call boundary.

Each semantic witness must first fail through the production boundary on the clean predecessor, then pass after the data-model cutover.

## Deletion and boundaries

Delete DirectCallFlow independent columns, the input_flow opcode match, the duplicate generic result enumerators in jobs/body.rs, jobs/artifact.rs, and executable_facts.rs, and the duplicate generic read enumerator in jobs/body.rs. Delete helpers and tests that treat local constants as semantic absence. Leave no frame side table, compatibility columns, second fact, display classifier, variant repair list, or proof-only probe.

Do not mechanically replace policy-specific semantic typing, codegen, or callable-escape analysis with generic reads. runtime_demand callable escape behavior requires its own production witness before any future convergence. Replacing ExprStep or introducing a macro-generated instruction schema is outside this ticket.

This ticket corrects the retained relation boundary landed by fz-kdt.214 and blocks fz-kdt.200. fz-kdt.200 owns the final finite joint question carrier, recursive solver, and activation cutover. fz-kdt.188 separately removes a fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow after semantic coalescing. Closed fz-kdt.81 and fz-1ah.8 cover different retained authorities.

## Acceptance

The retained relation distinguishes both falsifying witnesses. All input-flow value semantics come from the one LoweredStep role authority, its direct duplicate enumerators are gone, and downstream layers do not reconstruct discarded operands. The relation remains immutable, deterministic, replacement-aware, and allocation-retaining on equal reproduction.

Focused role, extraction, path, and question tests; serial library; serial fixture matrix; all three target doors; cross-process determinism; documentation checks; cargo check; strict clippy; formatting; and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the frozen diff before the one commit and close.
title: Preserve correlated semantic call frames in InputFlowRelation
